title: GemSim host transport simulated-memory extension
scope: bounded bridge-owned simulated allocation and memfd transfer only

capability.name: SIMULATED_MEMORY_V1
capability.negotiation: selected if and only if both offered and required by the client; offered-only is not selected; required-not-offered is the base subset failure; independent of QUEUE_CONTROL_V1

transport.crc: base protocol CRC-32C covers the control frame but not memfd contents

opcode_constraints.failure_ack: known nonzero status; echo request_id, opcode, allocation_id, and generation from the structurally decoded request; protocol version is 1.0; reserved fields, values, and sim_tick are zero; response header uses actual daemon UUID, current connection ID, and actual epoch; no descriptor

ack_rules.common: exactly one 144-byte MEMORY_ACK with no ancillary data; framing and memory version 1.0, known status, request_id echo, actual daemon UUID, current connection ID, actual epoch, and all reserved fields are exact
ack_rules.ALLOC_success: status OK; allocation_id in 1 through 1024; generation nonzero; value0 equals base + (allocation_id - 1) * slot stride without overflow; value1 and value2 exactly echo requested size and alignment
ack_rules.FREE_success: status OK; opcode, allocation_id, and generation exactly echo the request; value0, value1, and value2 are zero
ack_rules.COPY_H2D_success: status OK; opcode, allocation_id, and generation exactly echo; value0 and value1 echo offset and byte_count; value2 equals the zero-extended request CRC32C
ack_rules.COPY_D2H_success: status OK; opcode, allocation_id, and generation exactly echo; value0 and value1 echo offset and byte_count; value2 is the zero-extended immutable carrier CRC32C
ack_rules.failure: status is a known nonzero base status; opcode, allocation_id, and generation exactly echo; value0, value1, value2, and sim_tick are zero
ack_rules.runtime_validation: any ACK shape, identity, request correlation, reserved-field, value, descriptor, size, seal, or CRC mismatch after send poisons and closes the session

carrier.kind: receiver-verifiable anonymous sealable regular staging object transferred by SCM_RIGHTS
carrier.runtime_creation: a conforming runtime creates the object with memfd_create(MFD_CLOEXEC | MFD_ALLOW_SEALING), truncates it to the exact byte count, and sets mode 0600 before sealing or sending

common.receiver_fd_cloexec: required and established by recvmsg MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC; this does not prove sender creation flags
common.file_offset: ignored; all IO uses pread or pwrite from offset zero

COPY_H2D.commit: daemon reads all bytes, verifies CRC-32C, prepares sparse chunks, then atomically mutates simulated memory

COPY_D2H.commit: daemon snapshots simulated bytes, writes all bytes, applies final seals, re-reads the now-immutable complete contents, computes CRC-32C, and only then sends the terminal ACK
COPY_D2H.failure_status: a client-created writable mapping that prevents F_SEAL_WRITE is UNAUTHORIZED; carrier ENOSPC is RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; other pwrite, seal, or final verification failures are INTERNAL

ancillary_rules.drop_and_close: MSG_CTRUNC, malformed or unknown cmsg, more than one descriptor, or any descriptor attached to HELLO, QUEUE, ACK, or an unknown message type
ancillary_rules.malformed_ack: a complete memory request whose opcode has the wrong zero-or-one descriptor cardinality
ancillary_rules.unauthorized_ack: a correctly cardinalized carrier with the wrong type, owner, mode, size, access mode, CLOEXEC state, link count, or seals
ancillary_rules.ownership: every visible received descriptor enters move-only RAII immediately and is closed on every completion, rejection, disconnect, and shutdown path

error_precedence: DROP_AND_CLOSE invalid envelope, CRC, message type, frame or payload length, header reserved field, uncorrelatable request, or unsafe ancillary structure
MALFORMED correlatable flags, payload reserved field, opcode, opcode-canonical-field, or descriptor-cardinality error
PROTOCOL_STATE stale, foreign, freed, or out-of-range allocation
INTERNAL carrier IO, host allocation, or sealing failure

semantics.storage: bridge-owned sparse 64-KiB chunks; missing chunks read as zero; allocation does not eagerly commit requested host RAM
semantics.allocation_identity: slot IDs 1 through 1024 may be reused only with a new daemon-lifetime monotonic nonzero generation; generation never wraps
semantics.simulated_va: for allocation_id in 1 through 1024, address equals base + (allocation_id - 1) * slot stride with checked u64 arithmetic; this functional address is not yet packet-visible GPU VRAM
semantics.range: validate offset <= allocation size and byte_count <= allocation size minus offset before conversion to size_t or off_t
semantics.event_queue: all decode, allocation state mutation, sparse-byte mutation, and terminal ACK construction occur on the gem5 event queue; PollEvent only schedules service
semantics.request_id: the HELLO-seeded session-wide strictly increasing tracker is shared by queue and memory requests and never wraps; every admitted request that can receive a canonical ACK consumes its ID, including lifecycle, resource, carrier-policy, carrier-IO, and H2D CRC failures
semantics.indeterminate_ack: after a complete memory request and any required descriptor are sent, timeout, cancellation, EOF, or noncanonical ACK poisons and closes the session; a canonical non-OK ACK is determinate
semantics.deadline: one CLOCK_MONOTONIC absolute deadline is formed once after synchronous argument validation and covers memfd creation, staging, sealing, send, ACK, and successful D2H post-ACK validation; deadline precedes cancellation; timeout or cancellation before canonical ACK poisons after send; ALLOC, FREE, COPY_H2D, and every non-OK ACK are terminal immediately after canonical ACK validation; only successful COPY_D2H checks deadline and cancellation again before caller-buffer mutation, leaving output untouched and the known session usable if either wins; after final validated bytes are copied success is terminal without another cancellation check
semantics.queue_completion_interleave: while awaiting MEMORY_ACK, a canonical CP-0005 QUEUE_COMPLETION for a previously acknowledged queue request is validated and buffered without changing the memory request; a completion using the active memory request_id, or any other record type or noncanonical completion, poisons and closes the session
semantics.copy_atomicity: COPY_H2D changes no simulated bytes until carrier and CRC validation plus sparse-chunk preparation succeed; COPY_D2H changes no caller bytes until ACK, final seals, size, and CRC all validate
semantics.disconnect: disconnect frees all allocations owned by the client fd generation and closes every pending staging descriptor
semantics.runtime_handle_ownership: the opaque allocation handle is unique ownership; copied aliases must not be passed after successful free or instance close
